---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or capability for Legacy Player
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

Describe the feature clearly.

## Problem

What problem does this solve, and for whom (players, hosts, people who run a friends service, contributors)?

## Proposed direction

Describe the desired behaviour. If it is something players see, say how it should work in the normal window and in
TV mode with only a controller.

## Permissions and privacy

Does it contact anything outside the player's computer, share something with other players or a server, or change
something on the computer (router, firewall, files outside Legacy Player's folder, another program's settings)? If so,
say what would be sent, to whom, and how a player would undo it. Every such action needs its own permission
([CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#the-consent-rule)).

## Scope

Indicate which area this affects:

- launcher (library, emulators, controllers, saves, settings)
- TV mode
- online play (server, rooms, server codes, relay)
- friends and messages
- permissions and privacy
- runtime / adapter / game pack (research track)
- tools
- docs

## Notes

Add any constraints, risks, or related thoughts here. A change to the service's role or what it owns needs a
proposal under `docs/proposals` first.
